[doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]
EcoCard is the only true points-based credit card among the listed cards. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]
Cash-back card rewards are stored as points but redeem at 1 point = $0.01 as a statement credit or checking-account credit. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]

New Business Silver Rewards Card customers can earn 2x cash back on all purchases for the first 6 months if the account is opened during the promotional window from 2024-11-14 through 2025-11-14. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_012]

Business Platinum Rewards Card offers a first-year annual-fee waiver of $0 for new accounts opened from 2025-11-01 through 2026-02-28; the standard annual fee after the first year is $450.00. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_platinum_rewards_card_011]
Platinum Rewards Card earns 10.0% cash back on all eligible purchases and has a $200.00 annual fee. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_002]
